response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, qc_count, qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT status, qc_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_shares) SELECT status, qc_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
